Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units for assay CHEMBL5732041. Join molecule_dictionary to activities via molregno, and join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN to require structures. Filter by assay_chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5732041', standard_value IS NOT NULL, standard_relation IS NOT NULL, and standard_relation = '='. Return all qualifying activity rows without deduplication. Sort by canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, and standard_units.
